dashboard.flowMissing: Some power values are unavailable; the flow appears again once the device reports.

dashboard.signs: Battery **+ = discharging, − = charging**; grid **+ = importing, − = exporting**.
dashboard.remoteNote: Enter a **positive power** and duration in **minutes**, then press Start. Editing the draft does not change the device or a running task. TOU must be exited first. Enable the new entities on the device page. Heartbeats run internally; the current timeout is 60 s with self-consumption as the fallback (firmware validation pending).
dashboard.controlsOff: Controls are off. Enable **Allow control** in the integration options to change EMS mode, SOC limits and remote dispatch.
dashboard.noDevice: No EnergyLIB device found. Add the EnergyLIB integration first.

alarms.title: Device alerts
alarms.note: Times are HA observations, not the device event time.

dispatch.title: Forced battery charge / discharge
dispatch.note: Settings take effect when you press Start.
dispatch.runningNote: Edits do not change this task. Press Start again to apply them.
dispatch.invalid: Enter positive power and a whole duration of 1–1440 minutes.
dispatch.tou: Time-of-use is active. Exit it before manual operation.
dispatch.unavailable: Device or operation settings unavailable. Check the connection.
dispatch.offNote: Enable to restore operation entities; press Start to run a task.
dispatch.onNote: Operation entities enabled. Disabling first stops any active task.
dispatch.syncing: Enabling operation entities. Wait for Home Assistant to load them before starting a task.
dispatch.controlsOff: Control access is off. Enable Allow control in the integration options; remote charge/discharge still requires its separate opt-in.
